headline: ICON PLC Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Clinical research organization ICON PLC reported third-quarter earnings per share that beat analyst projections by $0.02, with revenues also topping forecasts.
why: ICON is a major provider of outsourced clinical trial and development services to global pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporations.

impacts.name: ICON Public Limited Company
impacts.why: Earnings beat indicates sustained demand for biopharma clinical testing and contract trial management.
